liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Spanish Jam** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Lengthy, well-developed jam with every band member adding variations; reviewer knows of no other full-band version; Reviewer found the Spanish Jam spectacular [4][19][30]
- **My Brother Esau** (2 reviews): Described as elastic and groovy; Audience recording has a dynamite Brother Esau [22][29]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Set one opens with Bertha into Promised Land and closes with China>Rider [22]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea described as sweet on the audience recording [29]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China>Rider closing the first set is a favorite; Scarlet>Fire then opens the second [24]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet-Fire described as extremely hot, with varied and interesting Drums and Space [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-09-04.sbd.clugston.tetzeli.fix-2193.35214.reflac.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 161 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1983-09-04.169013.mtx.seamons.ht173.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 170 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard had early mix fluctuations and a brittle sound in Bertha, especially before Phil's bass came in [2]
- **gd83-09-04.sbd.clugston.2193.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 161 min; rated 4.17/5 by 23 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard tape sounds better than the live sound did; the show itself was somewhat thin, likely due to altitude; Board is crisp and clean; one skip in Althea around 5:33, and speed sometimes seems fast; Reviewer calls this an unbelievably clear copy of the show [19][20][21][24]
- **gd1983-09-04.149228.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 22 songs; 168 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd83-09-04.beyer-senn.unk.10253.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 160 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [14]. Said about its sound: Audience recording by Beyer and Sennheiser mics is so good the reviewer is tempted to ditch the soundboard [25]

## Around the show

- Utah fans often felt neglected by the band; this show spurred the reviewer to attend the following Redrock shows [21]
- Very sparse crowd, smaller than even Santa Fe; plenty of room to dance twenty yards from the band [26]
- Mood was chill, and it was still daylight during U.S. Blues [26]
- Reviewer lived in Park City then, worked Sunday brunches, and had trouble getting the day off; it was a very short commute [27]
- Show came before the 1983 Red Rocks run and was not very crowded, perhaps skipped by tourheads [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-09-04.sbd.clugston.tetzeli.fix-2193.35214.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Scott Clugston and Bill Tetzeli; source: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT > CDR patched with MAC (2 Beyer M160s + 1 Sennheiser 441 blend) > Sony TCD5M > Sound Forge 5 > SHN) [1]
- **gd1983-09-04.169013.mtx.seamons.ht173.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)… [2]. Also: Soundboard pitch corrected slower through set one; cuts in Althea, Space and Spanish Jam patched; Executive Crew audience source patches a song break before Hell In A Bucket [2]
- **gd83-09-04.sbd.clugston.2193.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT > CDR [3]. Also: Master soundboard cassette copied to cassette, then DAT, then CDR; passed via Scott Clugston to abgd and etree [3]
- **gd1983-09-04.149228.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Audience Cassette; Nakamichi CM700 mics > Sony TC-D5M [4]. Also: Master recording from Bob Wagner, patched out of Jaime Poris; transfer by Charlie Miller; pitch correction aided by Joe B. Jones; A Beyer M160 and Sennheiser 441 blended audience source supplies a patch in Drums [4]
- **gd83-09-04.beyer-senn.unk.10253.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sony TCD5M > Sound Forge 5 >MKW .96f > Power Post 2K [14]. Also: The taper of this audience recording is unknown to the reviewer [25]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Park West Ski Resort - September 4, 1983](https://www.dead.net/show/september-4-1983) [33]
- Poster by Kathleen Elizabeth Fowler Grateful: [1983-09-04 Park West Ski Resort, Park City, UT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1983-09-04-park-west-ski-resort-park-city-ut-usa/) [34]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Scarlet Begonias](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/scarlet-begonias) [35]
